historical_D60_slots.provenance: Inherited legal ACTUAL past from the archived D60, not relabeled as new MODEL samples

mechanisms.proves: Cache key is exactly (branch,target,robot,tick); position/sigma/health are separately checked context. Formal feedback slots retain target/robot/tick with outer branch identity.
Historical unit test requests the same key/context repeatedly and asserts producer count remains one. This H1 recorded zero cache reuse.
mechanisms.verification_boundary: Cache-interface test evidence only; not an observed reuse event in the formal H1.

mechanisms.proves: Historical test separately changes position, sigma and health and expects rejection; current H1 conflicts=0.
mechanisms.verification_boundary: Formal H1 did not exercise any conflict rejection.

mechanisms.proves: Raw-key schema omits role/team/segment/stream. Cache unit test repeats identical queries under four nominal labels; transaction test verifies real role/team historical boundaries with a fusion substitute.

verification_boundary.reason: The stream loop label is not passed into query; this is repeated-query API evidence, not an end-to-end stream-change/fusion test. The transaction fixture uses fake_fuse. No such reuse is observed in this H1.

mechanisms.proves: Constructor checks historical slot digest/position/sigma and prepares copied history; query checks context and returns a deep copy without producer execution. Historical test uses MISSING and a forbidden producer.
mechanisms.verification_boundary: Unit inherited-slot fixture is MISSING, not a new VALID-slot experiment. Formal H1 inherited_reuses=0; do not claim an actual inherited-cache hit.

mechanisms.proves: Historical test creates separate KEEP/SWITCH caches, invokes each producer and checks a mutation of one cached slot leaves the other MISSING. Actual H1 branch/stream/endpoint identities are separately verified.
mechanisms.verification_boundary: Cache isolation mutation test does not itself exercise every possible pending/fusion-result mutation. New formal H1 does not intentionally inject cross-branch pollution.

mechanisms.proves: Unit test rejects foreign branch and tampered cached slot digest; hardening tests reject event/segment/endpoint branch relabel against independently fixed context.
mechanisms.verification_boundary: Do not infer a separately executed wrong-stream BridgeFrameProcessor test from a cache test.

mechanisms.proves: Formal per-endpoint records bind team, stream/frame, MODEL endpoint and consumed feedback. Observation fusion is counted separately from raw requests and policy WLS.
mechanisms.verification_boundary: Pure-state fixture substitutes fusion; actual observation/WLS execution evidence comes from this H1, not from that fixture.

mechanisms.proves: Validated staged assignment commit maintains service/unassigned intervals and endpoint identity; historical failure injection checks state remains unchanged. New H1 directly audited completed Branch objects.
Both branch ledgers share continuous cumulative counts; formal watchdog and read-only audit separately bind model observation/policy WLS and CPU/wall evidence.

record.cpu_scope: Retained primary-process handle + Windows Job total for all assigned descendants; child created suspended and assigned before resume

verification_boundaries: Historical repeated-query test stream labels are not real service/stream transitions. End-to-end same-tick segment-change plus real-fusion cache-reuse test is NOT_VERIFIED by those unit fixtures.
Historical inherited-slot fixture uses MISSING. Formal H1 has no inherited cache hit/reuse/conflict rejection; do not report such an event.
Cache mutation isolation test is not a claim of having separately injected every possible pending/fusion mutation or wrong-stream request.
